hooks.text: 三人联机精确对齐装备与技能时机，叠出过量协同伤害
hooks.excerpt: Up to 3 friends can face relentless swarms of Tems together. Don't have friends to play with? No worries, use the matchmaking system to find other Swarmers! Strategize, share resources(or don’t!), and take down increasingly more powerful bosses. Maximize your attack potential by coordinating gears and skills with precision timing, creating overpowered synergies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 战中升级直到最终进化，每次进化都会大幅强化技能与属性
hooks.excerpt: Collect XP after defeating enemies to level up, grow stronger, and unlock your final evolution. Each evolution brings massive power-ups to your skills and strength.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 联机阵亡后进入Ghost Mode，继续支援队友等安全复活
hooks.excerpt: Online co-op has Ghost Mode — Support your friends until they can safely revive you and rejoin the fight. Defeat isn’t game over, fight on in Ghost Mode!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
